description: ValidationPolicy (line 214) derives neither Clone nor Debug, making it impossible to log or copy a policy. TrustAnchor (line 177) derives neither Clone nor Debug. For a no_std library these derives have zero runtime cost. Not deriving them forces callers who want to log or clone these types to wrap them, which is needless friction. Add #[derive(Clone, Debug)] to ValidationPolicy and TrustAnchor. Note: Debug on TrustAnchor will expose the SPKI bytes which is fine (it is a public key, not a secret).
title: Missing derives on public types: ValidationPolicy, TrustAnchor, SignatureVerifier
